data_fields.name: base_hit_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: 128 of 256 (50 percent) before level and bonus terms

data_fields.name: level_gap_points
data_fields.donor_constant: scale(5 x (attackerLevel - defenderLevel)), about 12.8 points per level before truncation (12 for gap 1, 25 for gap 2)

data_fields.name: racial_hit_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: scale(attackerLevel) added for race IDs 1, 3, 5 (rejected for Frankendom)

data_fields.name: class_bonus_factor
data_fields.donor_constant: defender class IDs 9 and 12: chance = (chance x 8 / 256) x (defenderLevel + 1) (rejected for Frankendom)

data_fields.name: agility_to_hit_and_defence
data_fields.donor_constant: -1 at 45 or lower, 0 at 46, else (agility - 50) / 5 truncated; same value for defence

data_fields.name: strength_damage_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 at 43 or lower, else (strength - 48) / 5 truncated; melee only

data_fields.name: monster_swing_gap
data_fields.donor_constant: random real times 0.75 seconds, between swings (donor comment: arbitrary, difficulty tbd)

data_fields.name: melee_range_min
data_fields.donor_constant: 1.0 world units (squared compare) to start melee

data_fields.name: swing_hit_progress
data_fields.donor_constant: hit allowed once at animation progress 0.50 or more

best_idea: Make a melee hit one roll against a 0-255 chance: a 50 percent base, plus about 12.8 points per level the attacker is above the defender, plus the to-hit minus defence bonus, never below a floor that grows with the attacker's level.
decision_why: Take the shape (one roll on a fixed scale, level-gap term, level floor, the same roll for both directions) into src/fight/hit.ts with Frankendom's own base, floor and bonus values; reject the racial and class 9 or 12 rules (no race or class model in the duel) and do not copy the variable-step swing timer.
acceptance: A server test runs 10,000 seeded swings per pair: an attacker 5 levels above the defender hits 192 of 256 (75 percent) within 2 percent, equal levels hit about 50 percent, and a level-1 attacker against a large defence bonus still hits at the floor of 53 of 256.
